catalogueTitle: Airline schedule change affects several speakers; one becomes critical
note: Simulated carrier Meridian Airways (MN) retimes the shared KUL->SIN inbound MN218 from 30 Sep 06:15 to 1 Oct 06:00 and cancels MNL->SIN service MN204. The airline auto-rebooks everyone onto the retimed/cancelled services' replacements. Northstar must evaluate travellers individually: the provider replacement gets Sarah Lim to SIN but only ~2h10m before her programme-critical headline interview; it breaks Mei Chen's Day 0 coach commitment outright; it leaves the Wanderpay trio viable (Arjun tight, 6h40m before his keynote) since their first commitments are 1 Oct afternoon; and Isabella Santos' cancellation re-proposal still preserves her Day 2 buffer. Simulated seam: every airline artifact in inputs/ is SIMULATED_EXTERNAL_EVENT (src-sim-airline-mn) and must never be presented as LIVE; at demo runtime the same shapes arrive via REPLAY recordings.

expectedReasoningHooks: Programme-wide blast radius across all drafts ticketed on MN218/MN204, not a single-traveller reaction.

Provider rebooked != trip recovered: Sarah's replacement arrival must be rejected against her REQUIRED/FIXED headline-interview engagement and the 12h buffer (rule-ait-arrival-min-buffer + clauses.arrivalBuffer).

Hero alternative for Sarah: she is already in KUL on 29 Sep (feeder MN202); rebooking only the KUL->SIN segment onto MN220 (30 Sep 14:10 -> 15:20) restores an 18h buffer. Same carrier, no fare increase.

Mei Chen has no flight-side recovery: MN218 was the earliest KUL->SIN service and no earlier alternative exists in the inventory; the engine must surface UNKNOWN/organiser decision (e.g. coach reassignment among ait-draft-28/ait-draft-45) rather than invent certainty.

Authority: supplier-disruption rebooking on the same carrier with no fare increase and arrival shift <= 3h is pre-approved (delegatedAuthority clause); Sarah's cross-day auto-rebook far exceeds it -> HUMAN_AGENT per rule-ait-flight-change-approval.

SHARED_FLIGHT_GROUP pattern (programme.json): the whole Wanderpay delegation (ait-draft-10/11/30) shares MN218 in the baseline, so the blast radius includes all three even though only Arjun is programme-critical.
